name: furniture-layout
description: Lay out the furniture in a room at real sizes and draw it as a dimensioned SVG, with a script that fails the layout when pieces overlap or leave the room, block a door's swing, or leave a walkway, bed side, chair pull-back or wheelchair turning space narrower than it needs. Use when a designer or homeowner asks to "lay out this living room", "will a king bed fit", "arrange the furniture", "plan this office for 8 desks", "check the clearances", or has a room's size, its doors and windows and a list of furniture.

handoff.when: the room's size or its walls aren't settled yet, or the person wants the whole floor planned
handoff.purpose: Plan the rooms and their doors first, so each room has a size to furnish.
handoff.fallback: If floor-plan-layout is absent, ask for the room's width, depth and door positions, or take them from a drawing the person has, before placing any furniture.

permissions.notes: Reads the layout.json it is given and writes the SVG to the path passed with --svg.

model.rationale: Furnishing a room is design judgment: zones, focal wall and circulation traded against clearances, with a checker to iterate against.
